description: Use this when planning wheelchair ramp length from entrance rise. Returns the minimum horizontal run under ADA 2010 §405.2, cited width, landing, rise-per-run and handrail dimensions, and separate historical HUD accessibility cost cards with missing price cells visible. This is a planning guide, not a code inspection. (API Tool Calls, by Cowerx)

rise_inches.description: Entrance rise in inches; minimum horizontal run excludes landings and door maneuvering space.
